title: L.A. DOLCE VITA
canon: Neo-noir political drama — Fellini reimagined for surveillance capitalism. Ten episodes are ten days in present-day February, during Carnevale, no flashbacks: a presidential candidate caught on a live stream detonates fifteen years of secrets — a journalist's vanished fiancee, his hidden daughter, and the Chigi family's plan to claim her as heir. The arena is a fire-season Los Angeles that never stops burning, juxtaposed with Rome, Venice at Carnevale, and the Mojave desert country of Arizona.
look: Contemporary neo-noir in 2025 surveillance-capital Los Angeles: anamorphic, deep shadow, sodium and neon, smog-gold light, heavy film grain. High-contrast cinematography — deep blacks, amber practicals, a burst of Italian color only when the story crosses to Italy. The wildfires are never out: orange sky by late afternoon, ash in the air, fire glow on every horizon. Music and light come from diegetic sources; the camera never lets you forget the city is burning while the powerful eat.
note: Six tentpoles chosen where canon is strongest: the EP101 scripted spine (03-setting.md, 09y-comfyui-prompts/ep101-v02-stills-prompts.md, and the protagonist files 01-marcello / 02-aimee / 03-elizabeth, all status: canon). Venice Carnevale, the Olivetti, Michelangelo's silver-ring beat, Aimee's Route 66 ride, the glitter-gun rally, and the Santa Monica Pier corn-dog closer — each is a poster-grade frame named in canon. Cast refs come ONLY from the July 2026 'la-dolce-vita-*.webp' portrait set; the April 'l.a._dolce_vita_*.png' set is a different, superseded cast — do not mix generations. la-dolce-vita-BigJim.jpg and la-dolce-vita-weinstein.jpg strongly resemble real actors and are excluded as refs (house rule: no real-person likenesses; archetypes only), so the rally shot runs refless. The elizabeth webp is painterly — it carries face and red hair only, never its illustration style. 2026-07-16 — Story Law pass (STORY-LAW.md): six story shots appended, every frame showing what is happening and what is at stake — the EP107 hospital slap, the EP110 LAX custody handover, Mario receiving his heir in Buenos Aires, the EP102 Siena crypt sign, Enrico shot at Michelangelo's (EP109), and Elizabeth's Pearl Ranch homecoming (EP110). Mr. X and Frank Pearl have no ruled cast refs and run refless as archetypes; Mario uses la-dolce-vita-mario.png (classified July cast set in 02-stills/reference-manifest.md, but no webp master exists — flag for Marco's ruling).

stills.prompt: Il Ballo del Doge inside Palazzo Pisani Moretta, Venice, Carnevale, present-day February. A candlelit Gothic ballroom on the Grand Canal at midnight — Murano chandeliers and hundreds of real candles are the only light, warm flame-light on gilt and fresco, thin fog drifting at ankle height across the terrazzo dance floor, no electric color anywhere. A crowd of masked dancers in baroque costume fills the frame; in the foreground a young Korean woman in a black volto mask, one bare shoulder revealing a stark black rat tattoo, looks back across the crowd at someone we cannot see. Candle flames catch the wet glint of her eyes through the mask. Deep shadow between the chandeliers, faces emerging from darkness like a Longhi painting. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: Marcello's face and rumpled-elegant wardrobe carry from the cast ref; the prompt owns the room. The Olivetti is the series' central prop — brand shape matters, keys legibility does not.
stills.prompt: A writer's flat on a top floor near Piazza del Popolo, Rome, present day, seven in the morning in February. The only light is low winter sun pouring through tall open shutters, one hard golden shaft across a worn wooden desk, the rest of the room falling into warm shadow — no lamps, no screens anywhere. A ruggedly handsome Italian man in his mid-forties, two-day stubble, shirt and loosened tie, sits at a 1964 Olivetti typewriter, one weathered hand resting on the carriage, a battered antique silver ring on his finger catching the sun. Stacked books, crumpled pages on the parquet, an espresso cup, cigarette smoke curling up through the light shaft, a basset hound asleep at the foot of the desk. Ochre rooftops and terracotta chimneys of Rome soft through the window. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: Ref carries Elizabeth's face and red hair ONLY — its painterly illustration style must not bleed into the frame. This is the EP101 canon beat (she rolls her silver ring on the bar; its twin never leaves Marcello's hand).
stills.prompt: The long mahogany bar inside Michelangelo's on Sunset, an old-school Italian-American restaurant on the Sunset Strip, Los Angeles, present day, two in the morning after closing. The dining room behind is dark, chairs up on checkered-cloth tables; the only light comes from the amber back-bar shelves glowing behind rows of liquor bottles, one small brass lamp on the bar, and faint red neon from the Strip bleeding through the front window. A strikingly beautiful red-haired woman of about forty in a black evening dress sits alone at the bar, glamour fraying at the edges, rolling a small silver ring on the bar top with one finger, watching it circle. Everything else is deep shadow and warm reflections in the polished wood. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.prompt: Route 66 west of Kingman, Arizona, present day, late February afternoon. A nineteen-year-old all-American girl in a leather jacket rides a mint-condition vintage Moto Guzzi motorcycle low and fast toward the camera on the empty two-lane blacktop, hair whipping under an open-face helmet, a duffel strapped to the seat behind her. The only light is the low desert sun ahead of her in the west, huge and dirty orange through a distant wall of wildfire smoke on the horizon — the light of the city she is riding toward — throwing her long shadow back down the asphalt and rim-lighting the sagebrush and telegraph poles. Joshua trees and mesas soft in the golden haze behind. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.prompt: An outdoor presidential campaign rally in downtown Los Angeles, present day, harsh February noon under a smoke-yellowed sky — the sun is a hard white disc through wildfire haze, flat merciless daylight with no other light source. Gold glitter rains down over a panicked crowd like false snow, every fleck catching the hazy sun. On the flag-draped stage a towering silver-haired senator in a dark suit ducks behind his elegant composed wife, gripping her shoulders as a shield, her face registering everything. Secret Service surge up the stage steps, signs and phones scatter, and in the sharp foreground a fallen news camera lies on the asphalt still recording sideways. Frozen photojournalistic chaos, dread under spectacle. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: Elizabeth's face/hair from the cast ref; the real pier photograph holds the location's actual architecture and neon. The EP101 closer — bruised glamour and a flash of the girl she was. Avoids the garbled pier signage of earlier renders.
stills.prompt: The wooden rail at the end of the Santa Monica Pier, Los Angeles, present day, midnight in February. A glamorous red-haired woman of about forty in evening clothes leans on the rail eating a corn dog on a stick like a teenager, a smear of mustard on her chin, while a seagull on the rail two feet away eyes her. The frame is lit only by what the night provides: the carnival neon and Ferris-wheel bulbs of Pacific Park warm behind her, fireworks blooming cold and bright over the black Pacific, their color flaring off the wet rail and her cheekbones, and far up the dark coastline a faint orange line of wildfire glow on the Malibu hills. Cool blue ocean night against warm pier neon, melancholy and tender. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: EP107 ordeal (00f master, 00e brief Day Seven): Elizabeth's Alfa Romeo clips Aimee's Guzzi on Sunset; mother and daughter wake in adjacent beds; Aimee crosses the gap on one leg and 'slaps twenty years into her mother's jaw.' Elizabeth then names the price of the surgical work the slap has undone, and weeps. Refs carry face/wardrobe only; the elizabeth webp's painterly style must not bleed into the frame.
stills.prompt: A shared recovery room at Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, Los Angeles, present day, February, early evening. The ceiling lights are off: the room is lit only by green-white fluorescent spill from the corridor through the half-open door, the small amber LEDs of the bedside monitors, and one thin stripe of smog-gold fire-season dusk through the venetian blinds. A nineteen-year-old all-American girl in a hospital gown, cheekbone bruised, road rash down one forearm, stands balanced on one leg braced against the bed rail, her open hand still extended across the finish of a slap. In the bed, a red-haired woman of about forty, an IV line in her arm pulled taut, face knocked sideways by the blow, one hand rising toward her own cheek, mascara beginning to run. Behind the girl her own bed sits empty with the sheets thrown back, showing the gap she just crossed to deliver it. Twenty years of abandonment landing in a single frame. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: EP110 act-out (00f master, 00e brief Day Ten): at LAX Mr. X waits with international custody papers, a forty-eight-hour DNA result, and an Argentine passport; Marcello has no standing; Aimee boards the jet in tears behind a security perimeter. Mr. X — Mario's man in America (canon: 55, Harvard Club New York, the same enforcer who disappeared CJ twenty years ago) — has no ruled cast ref and runs as an archetype.
stills.prompt: The private-aviation ramp on the south side of Los Angeles International Airport, present day, late February afternoon. The only light is the low sun, a dirty orange disc through wildfire haze over the runways, throwing long smog-gold shadows across the tarmac; the open cabin door of a waiting private jet glows cold electric white against it. A nineteen-year-old all-American girl in a leather jacket climbs the airstairs in tears, looking back over her shoulder. At the foot of the stairs a composed silver-templed man in his mid-fifties, immaculate charcoal suit and black overcoat, holds an open leather folio with legal papers and a passport visible inside it, his expression patient and final, a man collecting a debt. Far behind them at a chain-link security barrier, a ruggedly handsome Italian man in his mid-forties, two-day stubble, rumpled shirt and jacket, grips the fence beside a security officer, watching his daughter being taken. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: EP110 close (00e brief Day Ten): 'the staff of the Chigi estate assembles in their finest to receive an heir, and Mario, in a wheelchair, kisses his granddaughter's hand and offers her everything.' Mario's Argentine holdings came through his wife Brigitte's cattle farms (canon backstory). Mario's ref is la-dolce-vita-mario.png — classified July cast set in reference-manifest.md but the only cast ref without a webp master; flagged for Marco.
stills.prompt: The marble entrance gallery of a Belle Epoque palacio off Avenida Alvear, Recoleta, Buenos Aires, present day, February — high southern summer, the opposite season to the burning northern city. Low golden evening sun pours through tall French doors down the length of the gallery, warm and humid, catching the crystal of unlit chandeliers; no electric light anywhere. The household staff — maids, cooks, a gardener, a chauffeur — stand assembled in their finest in a receiving line along the marble. At its head a distinguished seventy-year-old patriarch in an impeccable pale summer suit, seated in a wheelchair, bends forward to kiss the hand of a nineteen-year-old all-American girl who still wears her travel leather jacket, her duffel dropped at her feet. Her face is caught between grief and awe as an empire is laid in front of her. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.notes: EP102 canon (la-dolce-vita-canon.md, 00e brief Day Two): Marcello, still in the Venice tux with a faint black eye, rides the Guzzi to his mother's grave outside Siena, asks her for a sign, and 'a passing bird fouls the silver ring Marcello has worn for fifteen years, the twin of a ring he once gave a girl called CJ.' The stone placed at the crypt is the author's-note detail from canon. Same day Mario fires him — stipend, apartment, byline gone.
stills.prompt: The Cimitero della Misericordia outside Porta Tufi, Siena, Italy, present day, February, mid-morning. The only light is the low pale Tuscan winter sun raking across rows of marble family crypts, long cold shadows thrown by the cypresses, breath-fog in the air. A ruggedly handsome Italian man in his mid-forties, two-day stubble and a faint black eye, wearing a rumpled tuxedo from the night before under a dark overcoat, stands at his mother's crypt with both hands thrown up at the sky in exasperated appeal — he asked the dead for a sign, and a fresh white streak of bird droppings has just fouled the battered antique silver ring on his hand. A small pebble sits newly placed on the crypt ledge beneath an oval porcelain portrait of an elegant woman; a vintage Moto Guzzi motorcycle waits at the cemetery gates beyond. A man arguing with his mother's grave and getting an answer. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.prompt: The dining-room floor of Michelangelo's on Sunset, an old-school Italian-American restaurant on the Sunset Strip, Los Angeles, present day, night. The room is lit only by the amber glow of the back-bar shelves, one small brass lamp on the mahogany bar, and red neon from the Strip bleeding through the front window — the same warm closing-time shadows, now wrong. On the imported hand-painted Neapolitan floor tile a stylish, handsome Italian man in his mid-thirties in a fine open-collared shirt lies shot, dark blood spreading across the tile pattern, held in the arms of a ruggedly handsome Italian man in his mid-forties, two-day stubble, whose face is coming apart; the dying man grips his friend's lapel, mouth open on his last words. Behind them chairs are overturned, the front door still swings, and at the end of the bar a woman bartender stands frozen with the house pistol still raised toward the door. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.

stills.prompt: The front porch of a working cattle ranch off Route 66 in Mojave country east of Kingman, Arizona, present day, February, last light. The only light is the deep red-gold desert dusk on the horizon and one warm bare porch bulb over the door; the windmill and corral rails stand black against the sky. On the porch steps a weathered rancher in his early seventies — ex-Marine bearing, work shirt, suspenders — wraps his arms around a red-haired woman of about forty in city clothes, her face buried in his shoulder, his eyes shut, not one word between them. Behind her a single small suitcase stands dropped in the dirt drive and a taxi's tail-lights recede toward the highway: her first step up this drive in more than twenty years. Wide anamorphic composition, 35mm film still, heavy natural grain, cinematic. Full-bleed frame, no letterbox, no borders. No text, no watermark.
